mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_note_event_outbox(note_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{eventType}, #{payload})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_note_event_outbox SET payload = #{payload} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, note_id, event_type, payload FROM t_note_event_outbox WHERE (status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 1 AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE t_note_event_outbox SET status = 1, claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 1 AND lease_until < NOW(3)))
UPDATE t_note_event_outbox SET status = 2, sent_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND claim_token = #{token}
